# rd_fastps_ab and rd_fastps_ab_gl (test/rd_fastps_ab.cmake): a fixture, then
# the profiles it is replayed under (corpus, mali, mali169, desktop: the
# script's head says what each is; OpenGL replays every fixture at the corpus
# setting without dual-source blending).  Every profile without dual-source
# blending must draw some pass through the fast pixel build over the whole
# list (the count printed per fixture): a pass takes it only where its
# DrawCB is in the set (textured, MODULATE with TCC, an RGBA32 texel, no GS
# levels, nearest, DATE, clip plane or alpha test; rd_fastps.h), which a
# blank-rule texture's alpha (00..ff) under an alpha test does not allow; the
# vu_opaque.rules.txt fixtures have opaque textures, so their passes' tests
# are decided by the alpha plan.  The Mali profiles need a frame at least
# 16:9 wide.
#
# issue 179's Mali-G52 (v0.11.5): the stage 42 slow-scene capture, 912 wide
fx-mali-slow541 mali,mali169,desktop,corpus
# issue 179's Mali-G52 (v0.11.7) loss capture, 912 wide, opaque textures
fx-mali-loss-before mali,mali169,desktop,corpus
# issue 179's Mali-G52 (v0.11.4) loss capture, 912 wide, opaque textures
fx-scope-179-before mali,mali169,desktop,corpus
